name: Image generation — agent tool
summary: ImageGenTool attached to a Prompt Agent. Tool hardcodes gpt-image-1 and uses the x-ms-oai-image-generation-deployment header.
description: Tests whether the orchestrator model on the host agent can be BYOM while the image tool itself routes via the per-account image deployment header. BYOM does not apply to the image model slot.
notes: Skips with ::warning:: if IMAGE_DEPLOYMENT_NAME is unset.
